messages:
ivy: Heads-up: p99 in Latency -> Endpoints for /v1/embeddings moved from ~420ms to ~690ms after we flipped the routing weights this morning. p50/p95 look unchanged. anyone have quick theories?

noah: interesting. p99 only usually points to sketching/merging. did we tweak tdigest compression or sketch size in the rollout?

anya: we lowered tdigest_max_buckets on collectors to reduce memory for low-tier tenants during the roll, I flagged it in the rollout notes. could lose fidelity in the tail.

ops-bot: rollout "route-weight-adjust-2025-09-12" applied at 2025-09-12T08:11:05Z. collector.tdigest_max_buckets=50 -> 32 for tier=low.

ivy: that would do it. but the endpoint breakdown per-host still shows p99 ~430ms. rollup view shows 690ms. seems inverted.

noah: check include_retries and whether rollup uses merged sketches from ingress vs host histograms from workers. mismatch there can flip direction.

anya: confirmed: rollup p99 computed from merged tdigest at aggregator which ingests sketches from ingress collectors (with reduced buckets). host-level histograms are computed at worker and reported raw. include_retries default differs: rollup includes retries, host histograms do not.

ivy: aha. so combined effects: lower bucket count can inflate extremes in some merge patterns, and retries included only in rollup amplify p99.

noah: quick mitigation: temporarily set rollup include_retries=false and roll back tdigest bucket change for low tier collectors while we evaluate.

ops-bot: config-change applied: rollup.include_retries=false (at 2025-09-12T08:30:12Z). collector.tdigest_max_buckets scheduled rollback by anya.

anya: rolling back tdigest_max_buckets for low-tier now. will monitor.

ivy: thanks. long-term action: add sample_count + sketch_size + "quantile_source" pill on console panes so triage doesn't require digging. also update runbook noting not to downsample or reduce sketch fidelity during routing experiments.

noah: file MET-3011 for provenance UI and MET-3012 for runbook + guardrails.

ops-bot: tickets created MET-3011, MET-3012.

anya: post-rollback check: recompute raw p99 over 30m window = 428ms, host histograms = 432ms, rollup after changes = 430ms. alignment confirmed.

ivy: great, closing the loop. we'll include a short note in the rollout checklist to verify percentile parity after any routing or telemetry change.

noah: also let's add an automated check that alerts when rollup p99 diverges >20% vs host-level p99 for 5 consecutive minutes. prevents noisy surprises.
